## Activity

During March 2023, North City Eye Clinic recorded 534 captures. Activity was completed through the scheduled clinic sessions, with lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The reported volume provides the overall activity position for the month and indicates that capture work continued across the reporting period without a recorded disruption beyond that routine staffing arrangement.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for assessment. There were 11 ungradable images, representing an ungradable rate of 2.1 per cent. These cases were not suitable for grading from the available images. The ungradable rate should continue to be monitored as part of routine site review, with attention given to maintaining consistent image capture and supporting staff practice where required.

## Grading

A total of 126 results were graded referable during the month. The median grading wait was 1 day. This indicates that grading activity was completed within the reported operational timescale. The site’s activity, image quality and grading results should be reviewed together through routine performance monitoring, so that any emerging variation can be identified and addressed promptly.
